cases.sentence: Разве он не ___, не сын Марии, не брат Иакова, Иосии, Иуды и Симона?
cases.translation: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judas and Simon?
cases.explain: Плотник is the predicate noun identifying him → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Ирод приказал арестовать Иоанна и бросить его в темницу из-за ___, жены своего брата Филиппа.
cases.translation: Herod had ordered John arrested and thrown into prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) governs the genitive → Иродиады.

cases.sentence: Иисус ходил по окрестным ___ и учил.
cases.translation: Jesus went around the surrounding villages, teaching.
cases.explain: The preposition по (around/through) governs the dative → селениям, dative plural.

cases.sentence: Он созвал двенадцать ___ и начал посылать их подвое.
cases.translation: He called the twelve disciples together and began to send them out two by two.
cases.explain: Ученик is the direct object of созвал (called together); being animate, its accusative equals the genitive → учеников.

cases.sentence: ...и многих больных помазали оливковым ___ и исцелили.
cases.translation: ...and they anointed many of the sick with olive oil and healed them.
cases.explain: The verb помазать (to anoint with) governs the instrumental → маслом.

cases.sentence: Когда наступила суббота, он начал учить в ___.
cases.translation: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue.
cases.explain: В marking location (no motion) takes the prepositional → синагоге.

reading.ru: Разве он не плотник, не сын Марии, не брат Иакова, Иосии, Иуды и Симона?
reading.question: How did the people of his hometown react to Jesus, based on what they knew about him?
options: They took offense, seeing him only as the local carpenter
They welcomed him as a great prophet
They asked him to become their king
reading.correct: They took offense, seeing him only as the local carpenter
reading.explain: The people questioned how the carpenter, Mary's son, could do such things, and they took offense at him.

reading.ru: Он повелел им ничего не брать с собой в дорогу, кроме посоха.
reading.question: What did Jesus instruct the twelve to take with them on their mission?
reading.explain: Jesus commanded them to take nothing for the journey except a staff.

reading.ru: некоторые говорили, «Это Иоанн Креститель воскрес из мертвых, и поэтому в нем такая чудодейственная сила».
reading.question: What did some people say to explain Jesus' miraculous powers?
options: That John the Baptist had risen from the dead
That he was a Roman general
That he had learned magic in Egypt
reading.correct: That John the Baptist had risen from the dead
reading.explain: Some said John the Baptist had risen from the dead and that was why miraculous powers were at work in him.

reading.ru: В свое время Ирод приказал арестовать Иоанна и бросить его в темницу из-за Иродиады, жены своего брата Филиппа.
reading.question: Why did Herod have John the Baptist arrested and imprisoned?
options: Because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife
Because John refused to pay taxes
reading.correct: Because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife
reading.explain: Herod arrested John and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

reading.ru: Иродиада затаила злобу на Иоанна и хотела убить его.
reading.question: How did Herodias feel about John the Baptist?
options: She held a grudge against him and wanted him dead
reading.correct: She held a grudge against him and wanted him dead
reading.explain: Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him.

reading.ru: И поклялся ей, «Чего не попросишь, все дам тебе, хоть половину моего царства».
reading.question: What did Herod promise the girl who danced for him?
options: Whatever she asked, up to half his kingdom
Nothing, since dancing was not impressive
reading.correct: Whatever she asked, up to half his kingdom
reading.explain: Herod swore to her that he would give her whatever she asked, up to half his kingdom.

reading.ru: «Хочу, чтобы ты сейчас же подал мне на блюде голову Иоанна Крестителя».
reading.question: What did the girl ask for, at her mother's suggestion?
options: The head of John the Baptist on a platter
reading.correct: The head of John the Baptist on a platter
reading.explain: At her mother's urging, she asked for John the Baptist's head on a platter.

reading.ru: Когда об этом услышали ученики Иоанна, они пришли, забрали тело и похоронили его в гробнице.
reading.question: What did John's disciples do after he was beheaded?
options: They came, took his body, and buried it in a tomb
They asked Jesus to raise him
reading.correct: They came, took his body, and buried it in a tomb
reading.explain: When John's disciples heard about it, they came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал им, «Отправляйтесь в безлюдное место и немного отдохните
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the apostles to do when they returned from their mission?
options: Come away to a quiet place and rest
Go straight back out to preach more
reading.correct: Come away to a quiet place and rest
reading.explain: Jesus told the returning apostles to go to a quiet place and rest a while.

reading.ru: Он сжалился над людьми, потому что они были как овцы без пастуха, и начал их учить многим вещам.
reading.question: Why did Jesus have compassion on the crowd that found him?
options: Because they were like sheep without a shepherd
Because they were starving to death
reading.correct: Because they were like sheep without a shepherd
reading.explain: Jesus had compassion on the crowd because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them.

reading.ru: Все ели и насытились, и собрали еще двенадцать полных корзин остатков хлеба и рыбы.
reading.question: How much food was left over after everyone ate at the feeding of the multitude?
reading.explain: Everyone ate and was satisfied, and twelve baskets full of leftover bread and fish were gathered.

reading.ru: Но Иисус сразу же заговорил с ними. «Успокойтесь, это Я, не бойтесь».
reading.question: What did Jesus say to reassure the disciples when they saw him walking on the water?
options: "Take courage, it is I, don't be afraid"
"Throw your nets on the other side"
reading.correct: "Take courage, it is I, don't be afraid"
reading.explain: Jesus immediately spoke to them, saying, 'Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid.'

reading.question: What happened to everyone who touched Jesus' garment at Gennesaret?
reading.explain: All who touched him, even the fringe of his garment, were healed.
